title: Signed values
description: Tracked passes, receipts and results tokens. Each is base64url(JSON payload) + '.' + base64url(Ed25519 signature of the encoded payload). The signature is 64 bytes, so 86 characters.

trackedPass.description: Signed by the tracking Lambda, checked by the response Lambda. Expires at closing + 1 hour.

receipt.description: Signed by the response Lambda for adult open-link responses, checked by the tracking Lambda. Expires at closing + 1 hour.

resultsToken.description: Signed by DistrictWorkflow or the tracking Lambda, checked by the tracking Lambda before it issues results cookies. Expires 3 months after closing.

linkRef.description: base64url(HMAC-SHA-256(link reference key, surveyId + ':' + uuid)). Only the tracking Lambda holds the key.
